coverage_notes: Supplementary bounded recall only. Primary national production collection remains authoritative; this run made no editorial approvals, public publications, schedule changes or task disables.
All 12 targeted web searches executed. Results were dominated by dated historical events and 2025 SNAP shutdown references; no material web/source access failure.

Arvada CO Safeway closure story published Oct 13/updated Oct 14 (https://www.the-sun.com/money/17140327/safeway-closing-grocery-store-colorado/) predates window and misleads by describing only Safeway grocery; article identifies nearby Natural Grocers and Sprouts. Excluded.

Kenosha WI food bank permanent closure planned for end of 2026 was announced around Oct 21 (https://www.the-sun.com/money/17182682/kenosha-food-bank-wisconsin-closing/); excluded as older than observation window, and closure is not immediate.
Utah Heber City food pantry closure and Provo weekly appointment reductions were already captured in earlier Oct 27 Food Line watch and are duplicates.
Older 2026 El Paso TX storm-damaged food bank closure was Sept 25 (https://kvia.com/news/top-stories/2026/09/25/el-paso-food-bank-to-close-today-due-to-storm-damage/) and was not new.

Searches did not verify new canceled emergency distributions or in-window official SNAP/WIC benefit interruptions. A 2026 third-party SNAP shutdown page cited a future October 27 processing threshold but did not establish an official active payment interruption; excluded (https://www.snapbenefitscalculator.com/blog/will-you-get-snap-benefits).
Official/press search results frequently referred to October 2025 rather than October 2026. Publisher dates were checked to avoid confusing stale stories for fresh disruptions.
